reason.noLead: Not linked to a lead: do it within working hours today.

reason.firstContact: A new lead: call within minutes. Speed decides who wins the client.
reason.hot: A hot lead. Follow up within the hour.
reason.silent: No contact for {{days}} days. Reach out today before the lead goes cold.
reason.warm: A warm lead. Late morning tomorrow is a good time to talk.
reason.cold: A cold lead, {{days}} days since the last contact. A light WhatsApp check-in in three days is enough.
